Callout.Name: Carjacking in Progress
Callout.Message: Driver pulled from their car at a junction.
Callout.Advisory: Suspect drove off in the victim vehicle, northbound.

Script.Line: The engine was running and the door was open. I got in.
I did not pull anybody out of anything. Ask him.
It is a mistake. A stupid mistake.

Lines.Approach: They took the car and went north. Victim is shaken but on his feet.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
